subject: Quick note on Prestige Packaging's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Prestige Packaging stood out.

Plympton carton and box manufacturers on Bell Close - and prestigepkg.co.uk still opens with lt-ie9 / lt-ie8 / lt-ie7 classes, loads html5shiv.js and respond.min.js for old IE, pulls jquery 1.5.2, and locks the viewport at width=1105. Serious South West packaging capacity; a front end still wired for browsers Microsoft retired years ago.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
